principle: Each role receives a SCOPED subset of upstream artifacts, never the whole repository. Handoffs happen through files on disk plus an explicit, bounded prompt context.

scoping.coder: PROJECT_BRIEF + its own ticket + code of already-produced dependency files (context handoff, not the whole repo)
scoping.tester: PROJECT_BRIEF + the implementation files under test

growth_behaviour: Prompt size stays bounded because only dependency-ordered artifacts are passed forward; raw model output is kept on disk under runs/<id>/ rather than accumulated in context.
